summary: Comprehensive testing of Share Leaderboard feature on Promotion page. Backend: 14/15 tests passed (93%). Frontend: All UI features verified working correctly. The leaderboard displays rankings, period filters work, tabs switch correctly, and current user is highlighted.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'Referral code not found' - causes console error but page handles gracefully

backend_api_tests: GET /api/promotion/leaderboard - response has correct structure (period, leaderboard, current_user_rank, total_participants)
Leaderboard entry has required fields (rank, user_id, display_name, avatar_initial, total_shares, signups_driven, opt_earned, apps_shared_count, platforms_used, is_current_user)
Leaderboard ranks are sequential starting from 1
frontend_ui_tests: Promotion page loads with 3 tabs: Leaderboard, Share Links, Activity
Share Leaderboard title with 'Top promoters in the network' subtitle
Period dropdown selector visible with data-testid='leaderboard-period-select'
Period dropdown has All Time, This Month, This Week options
Period dropdown selection changes leaderboard data
Share Links tab shows app share links with signups and OPT earned
Activity tab shows recent activity with OPT rewards
How to Earn OPT section displays +100 OPT (share), +50 OPT (referral), +2 OPT (signup)

critical_code_review_comments: Leaderboard API properly aggregates shares by user with MongoDB pipeline
Period filters correctly filter by date range (weekly: 7 days, monthly: 30 days)
Current user highlighting works via is_current_user boolean field
Rank badges (crown, medal, award) correctly assigned to top 3
Frontend properly handles empty leaderboard state
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
seed_data_creation: None - used existing share data from previous tests

promotion_page_tabs.share_links: App share links with referral URLs

leaderboard_ui.period_selector: Dropdown with All Time, This Month, This Week

Leaderboard API at GET /api/promotion/leaderboard supports period filters (all_time, monthly, weekly). Current user is highlighted with (You) label. Top 3 have rank badges (crown, medal, award).
